A '''missile launcher''' or '''rocket launcher''' was a weapon that fired an explosive projectile.

==Description==
[[File:Rocketlauncher2.jpg|left|thumb|A [[HH-15 projectile launcher]].]]
A missile launcher fired a high-speed projectile with an explosive warhead. The standard [[Missile/Legends|missile]] exploded metal shrapnel in a 3-meter blast radius. Whether handheld and portable or mounted on a vehicle or vessel, missile launchers were common heavy assault weapons used by many military forces for artillery barrage. Missile launchers were necessary in various types of combat to destroy enemy vehicles and vessels, command stations, and eradicate large numbers of [[Soldier/Legends|infantrymen]]. An example included the [[PLX-1/Legends|PLX-1 portable missile launcher]].

==History==
[[File:BXseriesDroidCommando-Massacre.png|left|thumb|142x142px|A BX-series droid commando armed with a missile launcher.]]
In many different armies, certain soldiers were especially trained to use missile launchers. Those types of soldiers included [[Assault battle droid|Separatist assault droids]], [[Clone heavy assault trooper|clone heavy troopers]], clone [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|ARC troopers]],<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide">''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]''</ref> [[BX-series droid commando/Legends|BX-series droid commandos]],<ref name="Massacre">{{TCW|Massacre}}</ref> [[Clone commando/Legends|clone commandos]],<ref name="Clone Wars Campaign Guide" /> [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends#6th Regiment - SpecForce Heavy Weapon Specialists|SpecForce Heavy Weapon Specialists]],<ref name="Threats of the Galaxy">''[[Threats of the Galaxy]]''</ref> [[Rebel Vanguard/Legends|Rebel vanguards]], [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuards]] and [[Imperial shock trooper/Legends|Imperial shock troopers]].<ref name="BF II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

[[MiniMag shoulder-launched proton torpedo launcher]]s were used by pilots mainly within [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] hangars to quickly wipe out penetrating [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] that deployed foes.

During the end of the [[Battle of Onderon/Legends|Battle of Onderon]], seeing that the [[Onderon rebels/Legends|Onderon rebels]] couldn't destroy the [[HMP droid gunship/Legends|HMP droid gunships]], [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] sent [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]] to deliver missile launchers to them.<ref name="TCW:TP">{{TCW|Tipping Points}}</ref>

Missile launchers were also occasionally mounted to the fuselages of some spacecraft to provide them with heavy armament. For example, [[TIE Advanced x1/Legends|TIE Advanced x1]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] were equipped to carry and launch [[Cluster missile/Legends|cluster missiles]].<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref>
